properties.site-address: Sidac Sports & Social Club, Applecorn Close, Sutton, WA9 4NT
properties.notes: This sports club and larger playing fields site is subject to a live planning application for residential development.. Redevelopment of the existing playing fields for residential development comprising 129 dwellings with associated works (compensatory provision is proposed under P/2016/0200) and works to Sidac Social Club including the brick cladding of the toilet block, the erection of an entrance porch, the reconfiguration of the car park and the erection of acoustic fencing.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
